unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning a clinical LLM on EMR-distilled data and physician-derived instructions using curriculum learning
Reinforcement-learning reward alignment to physician diagnostic priors, risk thresholds, and heuristic saliencies

screen.reason: The paper introduces a fine-tuned clinical LLM (AI4Doctor) and evaluates it via expert physician subjective evaluation on clinical consultation tasks, but focuses on model development and evaluation rather than testing specific operational deployment practices or safeguards.
